pages.text: Wind whistled over the hill. Lolo climbed up, hugging a fish kite.
They wanted to fly it out over the sea. "Let us send it beyond those waves!"
Riri picked a blade of grass and tossed it. Lolo was already letting out the string. "We should check the wind first." "Running will make wind."
Riri tossed another blade, then another. Grass flew this way and that.
Meanwhile, a good gust swept past. Riri was still watching the grass.
Lolo ran across the hill holding the kite, running until out of breath.
The kite folded over and plunged nose-first into the sand. Lolo panted.
Riri's hat spun in the wind. The wind was blowing from the hill toward the sea.
With the wind at Lolo's back, Lolo ran toward the sea. The kite rose gently.
The fish kite swam over the sea. Lolo held the string, and Riri held Lolo around the waist. Whenever the wind grew strong, they stepped back and braced themselves.
